body:
Throughout this question, we are dealing with pandas DataFrame and Series objects. All code for this question, where applicable, must be written in Python. You may assume that pandas has been imported as pd.
The following DataFrame consoles contains the names of all major video game consoles. The name column is the primary key of the table. The type column contains the console type, which can only take on the values handheld and home. The sales column indicates the number of units sold in millions (rounded to the nearest million). The year column indicates the release year of the console. The data in the Generation, Sales, Year columns are all stored as int. All data come from Wikipedia, and the first six rows are:
• Playstation 2: generation $$6$$, manufacturer Sony, type home, year $$2000$$, sales $$155$$
• Xbox 360: generation $$7$$, manufacturer Microsoft, type home, year $$2005$$, sales $$84$$
• Nintendo DS: generation $$7$$, manufacturer Nintendo, type handheld, year $$2004$$, sales $$154$$
• Atari 2600: generation $$2$$, manufacturer Atari, type home, year $$1977$$, sales $$30$$
• Dreamcast: generation $$6$$, manufacturer Sega, type home, year $$1998$$, sales $$9$$
• Playstation 4: generation $$8$$, manufacturer Sony, type home, year $$2013$$, sales $$110$$
